name: Cito C1922

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: Lightweight folding race clincher with a 170 TPI casing (listing), sold at budget prices in China.
weight_basis: The listing gives 185 g without stating the size.

community.summary: Light (about 215 g at 25C) and grippy in the dry for one owner, but several riders found it very loud.

availability.note: Widely sold by mainland Taobao and Tmall shops; no official CST store was found, and CST's international site no longer showed model pages on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.market: 云天 优质正品 (Taobao shop)
price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: Only 23 and 25 mm were found; it is outside the 28 mm-plus trend.
Soft tread cuts easily, according to owners.

image.shown: Two folded CST Cito (C1922) 25C tires in an owner's post; the sidewall reads CST CITO.
image.alt: Two folded CST Cito road tires with their sidewall labels

rights.usage_note: A photo from a public Xiaohongshu post, shown from Xiaohongshu with a link to the original post; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: Lighter, softer and more comfortable than the Continental GSR it replaced, but noisy; small stones had cut several slits without a flat.
Feels oddly sluggish rather than smooth.

reports.exposure: Two years, about 5 km a day
reports.summary: Easily cut along the tread pattern, with several cuts reaching the casing, but good value.

checks.note: Two posts; a rim-brake rain ride is not tire-grip evidence
